title: CURE: An Efficient Clustering Algorithm for Large Databases
authors: Sudipto Guha, Rajeev Rastogi, Kyuseok Shim
description: Proposes CURE, a hierarchical clustering algorithm that represents each cluster by multiple well-scattered representative points shrunk toward the centroid, enabling it to handle non-spherical cluster shapes, wide size variances, and outliers in large databases via random sampling and partitioning.
